attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited has published its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at its meeting held on November 11, 2026. The publication was made in the Financial Express and Nava Telangana newspapers on November 13, 2026. The results are also available on the company website at https://terasoftware.com/quarterly-results. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company scrip code is 533982 and the symbol is TERASOFT.

attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr G. Venkatanarayana as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. December 04, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited has appointed Mr. G. Venkatanarayana as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel with effect from December 04, 2026. This appointment follows the resignation of Mr. G. Anitkumar. The Board approved the appointment on November 11, 2026. Mr. Venkatanarayana is a qualified Chartered Accountant with over 14 years of experience in corporate finance, tax audits, and statutory compliance. He has been in independent practice since 2016. He is not related to any Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the company. The appointment is on full-time terms as approved by the Board based on recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Audit Committee. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Intimation of Approval of Name Reservation by the MCA update under Reg 30
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited has received name reservation approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs for the new name Tera Corp Limited. The Central Registration Centre approved the reservation on November 11, 2026, with the letter received on November 12, 2026. The reservation is valid for 60 days under Section 4(5) of the Companies Act, 2013. The company states the change reflects its strategic pivot toward multi-domain flagship projects. The name change is subject to shareholder approval, in-principle approval from stock exchanges under Regulation 45 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, and final approval from the Registrar of Companies. The company confirms the change will not affect its legal status, constitution, core operations, or stakeholder rights. The company’s CIN is L72200TG1994PLC018391.

attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited approved un-audited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. G. Venkatanarayana as Chief Financial Officer effective December 04, 2026. The company approved a preferential issue of up to 5,14,491 fully convertible warrants to promoter group members Mr. T. Madhu Mitra and Mrs. T. Pavana Devi at Rs. 291.55 per security, aggregating up to Rs. 14,99,99,951. This proposal is subject to shareholder approval. The Board also approved changing the company name and altering the Memorandum of Association objects clause, both subject to member approval. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting is convened to seek approval for these matters.

attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 and outcome of Board Meeting
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company appointed Mr. G. Venkatanarayana as Chief Financial Officer effective December 4, 2026. The Board approved a preferential issue of convertible warrants to the promoter group, subject to shareholder approval. Proposals to change the company name and alter the Memorandum of Association were also approved, pending member approval. An Extra-Ordinary General Meeting is scheduled to seek shareholder consent for these matters. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 1,324.82 lakhs, compared to 1,115.83 lakhs in the corresponding period of the previous year. Earnings per share for the half-year stood at 10.14.
